June 9, 1976
Mr. J. L. Johnson, P.E. Department of the Army Fort Worth District P. O. Box 17300 Fort Worth, Texas 76102
SUBJECT: Environmental Impact Statement
Hydroelectric Generators
Lake Amistad
Val Verde County, Texas
Dear Mr. Johnson:
In your letter to me dated April 22, 1976, you requested that we comment on potential environmental and public health implications which may arise due to the addition of two hydroelectric generators which will alter the fluctuation pattern of Lake Amistad and the downstream flow patterns below Lake Amistad near Del Rio, Texas.
After a review of this matter by our Public Health Regional Offices, we are of the opinion that the proposed modifications would have little adverse public health effect. However, consideration might be given to an evaluation of how stream flow alteration may impact the disposal of treated wastewaters from the Cities of Del Rio and Eagle Pass, Texas, and the raw domestic water supply availability for the City of Eagle Pass and Maverick County.
We appreciate the opportunity to comment on the proposed project.
Sincerely,
Director
